<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" font-family="Impact,'Arial Black',Helvetica,sans-serif">
  <!-- Hungry Man: a grill over flames, the name stamped on in two hits, then the meats bar and the line. -->
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="hm_bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#1a0604"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#3a0e04"/></linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="hm_fire" x1="0" y1="1" x2="0" y2="0"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#ff3000"/><stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#ff9000"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffe060" stop-opacity="0"/></linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#hm_bg)"/>
  <path fill="url(#hm_fire)" opacity="0.85" d="M0 360 Q40 250 80 360 Q120 230 160 360 Q200 260 240 360 Q280 220 320 360 Q360 250 400 360 Q440 230 480 360 Q520 260 560 360 Q600 240 640 360 Z">
    <animate attributeName="d" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite" values="M0 360 Q40 250 80 360 Q120 230 160 360 Q200 260 240 360 Q280 220 320 360 Q360 250 400 360 Q440 230 480 360 Q520 260 560 360 Q600 240 640 360 Z;M0 360 Q40 230 80 360 Q120 260 160 360 Q200 225 240 360 Q280 255 320 360 Q360 225 400 360 Q440 260 480 360 Q520 230 560 360 Q600 265 640 360 Z;M0 360 Q40 250 80 360 Q120 230 160 360 Q200 260 240 360 Q280 220 320 360 Q360 250 400 360 Q440 230 480 360 Q520 260 560 360 Q600 240 640 360 Z"/>
  </path>
  <path d="M40 318 H600 M40 336 H600" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="6"/>
  <rect x="12" y="12" width="616" height="336" fill="none" stroke="#ffb020" stroke-width="4"/>
  <g opacity="0">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1" dur="0.01s" begin="0.4s" fill="freeze"/>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,-10;0,5;0,0" dur="0.2s" begin="0.4s" fill="freeze"/>
    <text x="320" y="110" font-size="92" fill="#ffd040" stroke="#5a1000" stroke-width="4" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="4">HUNGRY</text>
  </g>
  <g opacity="0">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1" dur="0.01s" begin="1s" fill="freeze"/>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,-10;0,5;0,0" dur="0.2s" begin="1s" fill="freeze"/>
    <text x="320" y="200" font-size="92" fill="#ffd040" stroke="#5a1000" stroke-width="4" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="4">MAN</text>
  </g>
  <g opacity="0">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1" dur="0.01s" begin="1.8s" fill="freeze"/>
    <rect x="90" y="222" width="460" height="40" fill="#5a1000" stroke="#ffb020" stroke-width="2"><animate attributeName="width" values="0;460" dur="0.4s" begin="1.8s" fill="freeze"/></rect>
    <text x="320" y="252" font-size="24" fill="#fff0c0" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="8" font-family="'Arial Black',Helvetica,sans-serif" opacity="0">▶ JUST THE MEATS™<animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1" dur="0.2s" begin="2.2s" fill="freeze"/></text>
  </g>
  <text x="320" y="292" font-size="17" fill="#ffe8c0" text-anchor="middle" font-style="italic" font-family="Georgia,serif" opacity="0">"She can't control you anymore, king."<animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1" dur="0.8s" begin="2.8s" fill="freeze"/></text>
</svg>
